Let me analyze this conflict.

Register: "Mettler-Toledo Instrument (Shanghai) Co., Ltd"
Document: "Mettler-Toledo Instruments"

Both are clearly the same company — Mettler-Toledo's Shanghai entity. The document version is a shorter form missing the "(Shanghai) Co., Ltd" legal suffix. This falls under "legal-suffix drift" or spelling drift = same-entity.

Best value: The register's canonical form is more complete and precise: "Mettler-Toledo Instrument (Shanghai) Co., Ltd". The rules say for same-entity, presumably the register's canonical form is preferred (as with number/year format differences explicitly saying register's canonical form). For applicant, the register carries the fuller legal name, so best_value = register value.

Verdict: same-entity, best_value = "Mettler-Toledo Instrument (Shanghai) Co., Ltd", why: The document's shorter form is the same Shanghai legal entity with the identifying suffix dropped, so keep the register's fuller canonical name.
